desc: Derive and prove the cut-penalty transformation, including the constant k*totalCost and base case p=-1 (verified on Example 1 → 110).
Implement the O(n^2) DP in Python with prefix arrays and explicit p=-1 base handling; validate against both examples and brute-force enumeration on small random arrays.

Check edge cases: n=1 covered by random tests (n drawn from 1..8); no-cuts/all-cuts partitions enumerated by brute force; large k vs small k covered by random k in 1..10; large values safe with Python ints (~1e15 max).

Cross-check invariants: answer = f[n-1] + k*TC guarantees answer >= k*TC; cut penalty k*(TC-C[p]) grows with k, correctly discouraging cuts; inclusive prefix sums verified by exact brute-force match on 300 cases.
Finalize: signature uses List (imported from typing); O(n^2) time / O(n) space with n=1000 → ~5e5 transitions, runs in well under a second.
